mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TEMP_VIEW.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TEMP_VIEW.PatientID ORDER BY TEMP_VIEW.SystemTime ASC) AS rn FROM ( /**全民健康信息平台：患者基本信息(门诊、体检...)-CDR_PatientBasicInfo**/ SELECT BRGH.Brid AS PatientID, '520000001258' AS AuthorOrganization, '榕江县中医院' AS AuthorOrganizationName, '' AS HealthRecordId, NVL(BRGH.Rysfzh, ZCXX.Sfzh) AS IdCard, NVL(ZCXX.Zjlx, '01') AS IdCardCode, '' AS HealthCardId, '' AS MedicalInsuranceCategoryCode, '' AS HealthInsuranceCardId, BRGH.GHXH AS SelfPaidCardId, NVL(BRGH.RYBRXM, ZCXX.BRXM) AS Name, NVL(BRGH.RYBRXB, ZCXX.BRXB) AS Sex, MATRIX_GET_BIRTHDAY(NVL(BRGH.RYSFZH, ZCXX.SFZH)) AS BirthDate, NVL2(BRGH.RYHYZKBM, ZCXX.HYZKBM, '10') AS MaritalStatus, NVL(ZCXX.Gjbm, '156') AS Nationality, NVL(BRGH.RYMZBM, ZCXX.MZBM) AS EthnicGroup, DECODE(NVL(BRGH.RYZYBM, ZCXX.ZYBM), 'X', '37', 'Y', '90', '0-5', '21', '1/2', '13', '2/4', '90', '2/9', '13', '4', '90', '4/3', '90', 'xs', '31', 'tx', '80', '27', '27', '5', '90', '4/5', '90', 'zz', '17', '1/9', '13', '2/2', '90', '3/1', '90', 'et', '90', '90') AS OccupationCategoryCode, ZCXX.Sj AS PatientPhone, NVL(BRGH.RYGZDW, ZCXX.GZDW) AS WorkUnit, '' AS WorkAddrPhone, BRGH.GHRQ AS SystemTime, FN_GET_CZYMC(BRGH.JZYS) AS Author, '0' AS PrivacySign, BRGH.GHXH AS SourcePatientId, (CASE WHEN (BRGH.BZMS = '体检登记') THEN 'HV' ELSE 'OV' END) AS SourcePatientIdType, '09' AS AddrTypeCode, MATRIX_GET_ADDRESS('09') AS AddrTypeName, ((SELECT T.XMMC FROM PU_SJZD T WHERE T.XMLB = '省级编码' AND T.XMBM IN (NVL(BRGH.RYXZZ_SHENG, ZCXX.XZZ_SHENG))) || (SELECT T.XMMC FROM PU_SJZD T WHERE T.XMLB = '市级编码' AND T.XMBM IN (NVL(BRGH.Ryxzz_Shi, ZCXX.Xzz_Shi))) || (SELECT T.XMMC FROM PU_SJZD T WHERE T.XMLB = '县级编码' AND T.XMBM IN (NVL(BRGH.Ryxzz_Xian, ZCXX.Xzz_Xian))) || (CASE WHEN INSTR(NVL(BRGH.Ryxzz_Xxdz, ZCXX.Xzz_Xxdz), '/') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(NVL(BRGH.Ryxzz_Xxdz, ZCXX.Xzz_Xxdz), INSTR(NVL(BRGH.Ryxzz_Xxdz, ZCXX.Xzz_Xxdz), '/', -1) + 1) ELSE NVL(BRGH.Ryxzz_Xxdz, ZCXX.Xzz_Xxdz) END)) AS Address, (SELECT T.XMMC FROM PU_SJZD T WHERE T.XMLB = '省级编码' AND T.XMBM IN (NVL(BRGH.RYXZZ_SHENG, ZCXX.XZZ_SHENG))) AS Province, (SELECT T.XMMC FROM PU_SJZD T WHERE T.XMLB = '市级编码' AND T.XMBM IN (NVL(BRGH.Ryxzz_Shi, ZCXX.Xzz_Shi))) AS City, (SELECT T.XMMC FROM PU_SJZD T WHERE T.XMLB = '县级编码' AND T.XMBM IN (NVL(BRGH.Ryxzz_Xian, ZCXX.Xzz_Xian))) AS County, '' AS Town, (CASE WHEN INSTR(NVL(BRGH.Ryxzz_Xxdz, ZCXX.Xzz_Xxdz), '/') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(NVL(BRGH.Ryxzz_Xxdz, ZCXX.Xzz_Xxdz), INSTR(NVL(BRGH.Ryxzz_Xxdz, ZCXX.Xzz_Xxdz), '/', -1) + 1) ELSE NVL(BRGH.Ryxzz_Xxdz, ZCXX.Xzz_Xxdz) END) AS Village, '' AS HouseNumber, ZCXX.YZBM AS PostalCode, NVL(BRGH.Rylxrgxbm, ZCXX.Lxrgxbm) AS RelationShipWithPatient, NVL(BRGH.Rylxr, ZCXX.Lxr) AS ContactPerson, NVL(BRGH.Rylxrdh, ZCXX.Lxrdh) AS ContactPersonTel, '' AS ContactIdCard, '' AS ContactIdCardCode, SYSDATE AS TimeStamp, 1 AS OperationType, NVL2((SELECT MAX(JSXX.ID) FROM YBJK_JSXX JSXX WHERE JSXX.ZYH = BRWZ.GHXH AND JSXX.ZFBZ = '0'), '1', '9') AS CardType, (SELECT SXJG.VALUE FROM YBJK_SXJG SXJG WHERE SXJG.SXBM = 'prm_yab139' AND SXJG.ID IN (SELECT MAX(JSXX.ID) FROM YBJK_JSXX JSXX WHERE JSXX.ZYH = BRWZ.GHXH AND JSXX.ZFBZ = '0')) AS IssuingRegion, 0 AS ModifyFlag, '10169' AS JRCSDM FROM MZYS_BRWZ BRWZ INNER JOIN GH_BRGH BRGH ON BRWZ.Ghxh = BRGH.Ghxh INNER JOIN PATIENT_ZCXX ZCXX ON ZCXX.Brid = BRGH.Brid WHERE TRUNC(BRGH.GHRQ) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND BRGH.Sfjz = '1' AND BRGH.Thbz = '0' UNION ALL /**全民健康信息平台：患者基本信息(住院)-CDR_PatientBasicInfo**/ SELECT RYDJ.Brid AS PatientID, '520000001258' AS AuthorOrganization, '榕江县中医院' AS AuthorOrganizationName, '' AS HealthRecordId, NVL(RYDJ.Rysfzh, ZCXX.Sfzh) AS IdCard, NVL(ZCXX.Zjlx, '01') AS IdCardCode, '' AS HealthCardId, '' AS MedicalInsuranceCategoryCode, '' AS HealthInsuranceCardId, RYDJ.Zyh AS SelfPaidCardId, NVL(RYDJ.Rybrxm, ZCXX.BRXM) AS Name, NVL(RYDJ.RYBRXB, ZCXX.BRXB) AS Sex, MATRIX_GET_BIRTHDAY(NVL(RYDJ.RYSFZH, ZCXX.SFZH)) AS BirthDate, NVL2(RYDJ.RYHYZKBM, ZCXX.HYZKBM, '10') AS MaritalStatus, NVL(ZCXX.Gjbm, '156') AS Nationality, NVL(RYDJ.RYMZBM, ZCXX.MZBM) AS EthnicGroup, DECODE(NVL(RYDJ.RYZYBM, ZCXX.ZYBM), 'X', '37', 'Y', '90', '0-5', '21', '1/2', '13', '2/4', '90', '2/9', '13', '4', '90', '4/3', '90', 'xs', '31', 'tx', '80', '27', '27', '5', '90', '4/5', '90', 'zz', '17', '1/9', '13', '2/2', '90', '3/1', '90', 'et', '90', '90') AS OccupationCategoryCode, ZCXX.Sj AS PatientPhone, NVL(RYDJ.RYGZDW, ZCXX.GZDW) AS WorkUnit, '' AS WorkAddrPhone, RYDJ.Ryrq AS SystemTime, FN_GET_CZYMC(RYDJ.Zyys) AS Author, '0' AS PrivacySign, RYDJ.Zyh AS SourcePatientId, 'IV' AS SourcePatientIdType, '09' AS AddrTypeCode, MATRIX_GET_ADDRESS('09') AS AddrTypeName, ((SELECT T.XMMC FROM PU_SJZD T WHERE T.XMLB = '省级编码' AND T.XMBM IN (NVL(RYDJ.RYXZZ_SHENG, ZCXX.XZZ_SHENG))) || (SELECT T.XMMC FROM PU_SJZD T WHERE T.XMLB = '市级编码' AND T.XMBM IN (NVL(RYDJ.Ryxzz_Shi, ZCXX.Xzz_Shi))) || (SELECT T.XMMC FROM PU_SJZD T WHERE T.XMLB = '县级编码' AND T.XMBM IN (NVL(RYDJ.Ryxzz_Xian, ZCXX.Xzz_Xian))) || (CASE WHEN INSTR(NVL(RYDJ.Ryxzz_Xxdz, ZCXX.Xzz_Xxdz), '/') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(NVL(RYDJ.Ryxzz_Xxdz, ZCXX.Xzz_Xxdz), INSTR(NVL(RYDJ.Ryxzz_Xxdz, ZCXX.Xzz_Xxdz), '/', -1) + 1) ELSE NVL(RYDJ.Ryxzz_Xxdz, ZCXX.Xzz_Xxdz) END)) AS Address, (SELECT T.XMMC FROM PU_SJZD T WHERE T.XMLB = '省级编码' AND T.XMBM IN (NVL(RYDJ.RYXZZ_SHENG, ZCXX.XZZ_SHENG))) AS Province, (SELECT T.XMMC FROM PU_SJZD T WHERE T.XMLB = '市级编码' AND T.XMBM IN (NVL(RYDJ.Ryxzz_Shi, ZCXX.Xzz_Shi))) AS City, (SELECT T.XMMC FROM PU_SJZD T WHERE T.XMLB = '县级编码' AND T.XMBM IN (NVL(RYDJ.Ryxzz_Xian, ZCXX.Xzz_Xian))) AS County, '' AS Town, (CASE WHEN INSTR(NVL(RYDJ.Ryxzz_Xxdz, ZCXX.Xzz_Xxdz), '/') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(NVL(RYDJ.Ryxzz_Xxdz, ZCXX.Xzz_Xxdz), INSTR(NVL(RYDJ.Ryxzz_Xxdz, ZCXX.Xzz_Xxdz), '/', -1) + 1) ELSE NVL(RYDJ.Ryxzz_Xxdz, ZCXX.Xzz_Xxdz) END) AS Village, '' AS HouseNumber, ZCXX.YZBM AS PostalCode, NVL(RYDJ.Rylxrgxbm, ZCXX.Lxrgxbm) AS RelationShipWithPatient, NVL(RYDJ.Rylxr, ZCXX.Lxr) AS ContactPerson, NVL(RYDJ.Rylxrdh, ZCXX.Lxrdh) AS ContactPersonTel, '' AS ContactIdCard, '' AS ContactIdCardCode, SYSDATE AS TimeStamp, 1 AS OperationType, NVL2((SELECT MAX(DJXX.Id) FROM YBJK_DJXX DJXX WHERE DJXX.Zyh = RYDJ.Zyh AND DJXX.Zfbz = '0'), '1', '9') AS CardType, (SELECT SXJG.VALUE FROM YBJK_SXJG SXJG WHERE SXJG.SXBM = 'prm_yab139' AND SXJG.ID IN (SELECT MAX(DJXX.Id) FROM YBJK_DJXX DJXX WHERE DJXX.Zyh = RYDJ.Zyh AND DJXX.Zfbz = '0')) AS IssuingRegion, 0 AS ModifyFlag, '10169' AS JRCSDM FROM INHOS_RYDJ RYDJ INNER JOIN PATIENT_ZCXX ZCXX ON ZCXX.Brid = RYDJ.Brid WHERE TRUNC(RYDJ.RYRQ) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND RYDJ.Ifzf = '0' ) TEMP_VIEW WHERE TEMP_VIEW.ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND TEMP_VIEW.IDCARD IS NOT NULL AND TEMP_VIEW.ISSUINGREGION IS NOT NULL AND TEMP_VIEW.PatientPhone IS NOT NULL ) RANKED WHERE rn = 1
